method: ADMIXTURE 1.4.0, K=3, seed=20261012, genotype-derived; old unmapped Q is not relabeled or reused

spacing.selection: first biallelic SNP at least 100 kb after preceding retained SNP per chromosome; genotype QC follows

qc: MAF>=0.05; SNP missing fraction<=0.10; physical spacing 100kb (not an assertion of full LD independence)
sample_order_validation: fresh PLINK FAM equals source VCF header exactly
scope: small-marker population structure covariate for functional benchmark; K fixed by revised benchmark design, not inferred optimal
